rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for land used or suitable for farming.

example.english: This plot of farmland used to grow vegetables.
example.traditional: 呢幅農地以前係種菜嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 nung4 dei6 ji5 cin4 hai6 zung3 coi3 ge3

rows.note: Use this when you are picturing cultivated agricultural fields in particular.

example.english: This year's farmland had a pretty good harvest.
example.jyutping: gam1 nin4 di1 nung4 tin4 sau1 sing4 m4 co3

rows.note: Use this broader, more colloquial term when the context makes clear that the fields are farmland.

example.english: There is still some farmland in the village that nobody farms.
example.traditional: 村入面仲有啲田地冇人耕。
example.jyutping: cyun1 jap6 min6 zung6 jau5 di1 tin4 dei6 mou5 jan4 gaang1
